problem_context.input_output_contract: With only abstract state and required literal-map ownership. Require either null with GlobalStrings or non-null store_circular_area(state,circular_area) with GlobalStrings. Ensure null/error preserves GlobalStrings; live branch preserves store_circular_area and GlobalStrings and returns the logical full predicate result.
preferred_hidden_properties: Use ca_contents length versus ca_capacity for the public full result; relate it internally to equal indices and b_status through CircularAreaLogicalState.
problem_context.problem_statement: Reverify the real CRTOS CircularAreaIsFull with the unified idmanager-style circular_area_state/store_circular_area resource. Preserve every executable C token and existing logging behavior; only annotations and the case lib may change. The public spec must not expose data_buffer, operations, readidx, writeidx, b_status, or physical storage.
spec_hint: Reuse the shared circular_area_state, CircularAreaValid, and store_circular_area definitions. Representation witnesses must be opened only in an internal assertion, not listed in the public With.

source_goal_version.digest_input_policy: relative_path+sha256+state+role over generated files and witness statements
